candidates.name: Pink Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The dropped oversized body, loud plaid, long hem and novelty pink accessory styling read streetwear Casual rather than Formal Evening.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution review reveals a textured open overshirt layered over a white tee, with rolled cuffs and a long rounded hem; the color is good but the construction is too Casual.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The pale gingham check, exposed contrast buttons and casual untucked body do not provide the clean evening formality required.

candidates.name: Apricot Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The brown check, open overshirt styling and boxy casual body function as a light jacket rather than a Formal shirt.

candidates.name: Blue Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The broad body and two large utility chest pockets make this a workwear overshirt, not a refined Formal Evening top.

candidates.name: Purple Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Purple is promising, but the dropped shoulder, long boxy body and oversized utility pockets create a loose casual shirt-jacket silhouette.

candidates.name: White Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The four visible safari-style pockets, open collar and beach setting make this a Resort layer rather than Formal Evening shirting.

candidates.name: Light-Apricot Mandarin Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The clean mandarin silhouette is credible, but its near-white linen tone beside brown trousers supplies no Spring color and reads daytime minimalist rather than polished evening.

candidates.name: Brown Double-Pleat Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The consolidated gallery shows a narrow thigh and close lower leg with a cropped ankle line. Double pleats do not compensate for the skinny-looking silhouette, so it cannot anchor a modern Formal outfit.

candidates.name: Khaki Regular Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: It is clean but visibly narrower, lower-rise and more conventional than the pleated option, producing a dated office rather than Formal silhouette.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated crop omits rise, seat, full length and on-body drape; apparent light color is not enough to prove Formal tailoring.

candidates.name: Navy Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The very broad navy leg visibly puddles over the shoe and would make the Spring Formal palette dark and bottom-heavy.

candidates.name: Camel Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The low casual rise, broad leg and heavy sneaker stacking create the baggy Casual silhouette excluded from Formal.

candidates.name: Gray Drawstring Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The exposed rope drawstring, gathered elastic waist and soft lounge drape are not credible Formal Evening tailoring.
